notes: Ship 1 (display + compose + additive backend config). The 5 offer mechanics are ALREADY priced server-side by offer.service.resolveOfferDiscount, called by BOTH placeOrder (online, line ~1107) and the pay-at-store paths — verified. So this ship is mostly client + one additive backend field: (1) brandOffers.adapter now carries a sanitized `config` (tiers/buy-get/bundle products/gift pairs) on each feed item so the product page can render the type-specific block + know which items to compose [gated by SECTION_ENGINE_OFFERS, already ON in prod; additive — consumers ignore the new field]; (2) src/utils/offerMechanics.js (offerKind/offerMeta/composeCart/orderLines/bundleSavings); (3) src/components/OfferBlock.js (per-type product-page block from the locked mockup); (4) ProductDetailScreen renders OfferBlock + dispatchCta now composes the cart (BOGO adds free item, bundle adds the set, free_gift adds the gift) so the existing checkout carries the right items and the server prices them. Dual CTA (online / pay-at-store) already flows from offer.availing_modes.
